samples.src: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí ṣàkíyèsí pé ẹ̀jẹ̀ dídì lára aláìsàn RA ń tètè ṣarajọ ju ti àwọn ẹ̀nìyàn tí àlàáfíà wọn pé lọ, bákan náà pé àwọ̀n èròjà amáradàgbà tí a fi ṣẹ̀dá, wọn nípọn lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ jù amẹ́jẹ̀dì lásán lọ.
samples.ref: The researchers noticed that clots from RA patients formed faster than those in healthy individuals, and that the protein strands they were made of were also significantly thicker than normal fibrins.

samples.ref: There were also changes to the amino acids that make up the fibrin proteins, which caused them to trigger the body’s immune response, leading to further inflammation.

samples.src: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ti tẹ́lẹ̀ kán wo bí àwọn ìdun ṣe pín sí ní Africa, tí Botswana jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára wọn, ṣùgbọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣe sọ, ti wọn ló kọ́kọ́ ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó wà láàárín ìdun àti àwọn àìsàn tí àwọn ẹran ìsìn ń ní látara ìdun ní Botswana.
samples.ref: Other studies in the past looked at how ticks were distributed in Africa, including Botswana, but according to the researchers, theirs was the first to look at the relationship between ticks and heartwater cases in Botswana.

samples.src: Wọ́n sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn àìsàn tí àwọn ẹran ìsìn ní látara ìdun tí àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko kọ sílẹ̀ lè kéré ju èyí tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ti rí lọ, nítorí àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko máa ń sábà ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún irúfẹ́ àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà yìí nígbà tí ẹran náà bá ti kú, ní èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé wọn kìí ka àwọn ẹran ìsìn tí wọ́n ṣì wà láàyè tí wọ́n ní àìsàn yìí tàbí àwọn tí ara wọn ṣẹ̀ ń yá.
samples.ref: They said the cases of heartwater recorded by veterinary doctors might actually be less than the actual cases experienced by farmers, because veterinary doctors usually only test for heartwater disease when an animal has died, meaning that animals living with the disease or animals that recovered are not always counted.

samples.src: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gbà wọ́n níyànjú pé kí wọ́n la àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà lọ́yè lórí bí wọ́n ṣe lè ṣàkóso àti ṣe ìtọ́jú àwọn àìsàn tí ẹran ìsìn wọ́n ní nípa ìdun, láti lè dín wàhálà náà kù ní àgbègbè náà.
samples.ref: The researchers recommended that farmers should be educated on how to control and manage heartwater disease in their livestock, so as to reduce its burden in the area.
